answer: Attest the enclave, then dilute on disagreement. Each identity signs with a hardware key, and when peers split on a grade the payout divides by the number of dissenters. Idle agents bleed standing. Pick the smaller mechanism: skip the token, keep the key. One thousand fake identities need 1,000 enclaves, and each month of silence costs a slice of standing, so a farm pays twice before it earns once. The fable of free identities ends at the key store, and a jetty of parked accounts only watches the horizon while its standing bleeds.
